dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-lateral apex toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin at the mid-body transition.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a low-intensity grey median value.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish clusters localized on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white baseline and the posterior greyish texture.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast, dark oval feature on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Topological depression causing a localized dark shadow at the anterior dorsal axis.
